protocol.purpose: Evaluate compact Opura 0.2.12 real RustPBX mono 48 kHz Opus to PCMU egress. Both arms retain the same 48-to-8 kHz resampler and encoder. Same binary for all arms.
protocol.offering: 12 packets of untimed warmup per leg; all legs synchronized due every 20ms on a single Linux CPU. New process for every observation. Each leg remains on its assigned source through the final packet. Corpora/legs repeated across processes, never cyclically replayed inside a stream.
protocol.cpu: Linux process user + system ticks in timed window, divided by ticks/s and offered duration (batches * 20ms); process startup, allocation and first 12 packets before clock. Includes egress, checksums and pacing overhead. Paired within-scenario ratios compare fractions of one core.
protocol.memory: End-of-timed-window whole worker VmRSS in KiB, process lifetime VmHWM reported after timing, both divided by 1024 for MiB.
protocol.latency: Time from scheduled batch release through all PCMU frames and FNV checks. Miss iff latency_ns > 20000000. Nearest-rank pooled p99, per-process counts and worst per-process stall, include all processes.
protocol.output_gate: Exactly prescribed packets and 160-byte PCMU frames, every paired arm same FNV and silence count, independent 15-leg complete payload qualification for each corpus vs stock.
protocol.workload_replacement_gate: Prespecified 20% lower median final RSS, paired geometric CPU ratio no greater than 1, zero additional counted late batches in aggregate separately in each stock comparison at 250 and 500 Golos and at 500 AMI. Any failure prevents an unconditional replacement claim for this workload; conditions of shared host limit generalization.
protocol.uncertainty: Report range of eight/four within-round ratios; mirrored order balances placement. Paired CPU ratio geometric mean. Do not pool scenarios or treat individual batches as independent experiments.
